card.name: Years and session numbers in web lists
card.fires_on: The first digit of a year in a book citation or copyright line, and the space before a list number such as Session 3 or the year after a date. It appears on web pages of book lists and course outlines.

modes.label: Year digits in citations
modes.description: The first digit of a publication or copyright year inside parentheses after a publisher name.

modes.label: Numbered list items
modes.description: The space just before the next number in a series like Session 1, Session 2, Session 3, or just before a year after a date.

card.plain: It fires on the number part of a year or a session number in a reference list, where a digit is about to come next.
